name: 🔨⛵Whatever Floats your Boat
desc:
Whatever Floats your Boat is a game about building a new boat and then testing your design against others. With motors, weapons, and other interactive items, you'll never know what kind of crazy antics are going to unfold. ⛵ Need help? Checkout the Whatever Floats your Boat wiki! See in game changelog (under settings) for more!

Can you survive?
